panel.memory.title: Memory & Vector Store
panel.memory.desc: Manage memory records, model indexes and vector backends
panel.memory.desc_text: Memory text is the source of truth; each embedding model gets its own vector collection. Switching models only changes configuration and never rebuilds automatically.
panel.memory.task_busy: Another build task is already running.
panel.memory.indexes_hint: One collection per model; switching back to a built model is instant.
panel.memory.no_indexes: No model index has been built yet.
panel.memory.backend_readonly: Read-only: the vector backend comes from appsettings.json and cannot be switched while running.
panel.memory.backend_file_missing: This file was not found. If the app is launched from another directory, check the working directory.
panel.memory.backend_step_edit: Open the appsettings.json shown above in any text editor.
panel.memory.backend_values_scope: Scope: PerOwner (one file per owner) or PerCollection (one file per collection).
panel.memory.backend_step_restart: Save the file and restart the app; the change takes effect on the next start.
panel.memory.backend_no_disk: The InMemory backend keeps vectors in process memory and writes no vectors to disk; memory text is still stored in the memory database.
panel.memory.agent.desc: Browse, edit and sync this agent's memory
panel.memory.agent.title: Memory
panel.memory.chat.desc: Memory status and last recall in this chat
panel.memory.chat.title: Memory
panel.memory.chat.not_ready: Memory index is not ready; no memory will be injected.
panel.memory.chat.no_recall: No recall recorded for this chat yet.
panel.memory.chat.no_hits: The last recall returned no memories.
panel.memory.memory_records_path_hint: Memory text is always stored on disk here; the vector backend only stores derived embeddings.
